core_obligations: The product decompositions (proof lines 3742-3752): for K = {U_i}_{i in I} the category Sh(C/K) decomposes as the product of the categories Sh(C/U_i), and F(K)^# = coprod h_{U_i}^# (coproduct in sheaves), so Sh(C)/F(K)^# is the product of the categories Sh(C)/h_{U_i}^#.

Parts (1) and (2) (lines 3747-3752): the equivalence j_! : Sh(C/K) -> Sh(C)/F(K)^# and the correspondence j^{-1} |-> (F |-> (F x F(K)^# -> F(K)^#)) follow componentwise from the Sites lemmas on the essential image of j_! and the computation of j^{-1}.

Part (3) (lines 3754-3772): for f : K -> L given by alpha : I -> J and f_i : U_i -> V_{alpha(i)}, the functor f^{-1} corresponds, under the identifications of (1), to the base-change functor Sh(C)/F(L)^# -> Sh(C)/F(K)^#, (G -> F(L)^#) |-> (G x_{F(L)^#} F(K)^# -> F(K)^#), by applying the explicit relocalization lemma to each component morphism.
proof_roadmap: Decompose both sides as products over the objects of the semi-representable covering.
Transfer the single-object localization equivalence and its inverse description componentwise.
Transfer the relocalization description for morphisms componentwise.
